rows.label: Rank 4, Hot & Fresh
rows.note: 70,000 standing, 100,000 Höllars, 25 Techrot Chitin, 25 Necracoil, 40 Efervon Sample

conditions: Rank 4 is a story and chemistry gate, not just a standing gate: 70,000 banked standing does nothing until every member is Liked and the Finale is done.
Liked chemistry only unlocks at Rank 3, so build it there before ranking up.
bonuses: DirectGiftz gifts are a no-reading shortcut to chemistry; community wishlist posts list what each member likes.
Bounties that feature the member you still need earn their chemistry while you farm standing anyway.

rows.alt: 3.92% per Tier 5 Central Mall bounty, Lvl 105-110

conditions: Hand in Hex Treasures found during missions to Lettie to top off the cap.
bonuses: Clearing all three Temporal Archimedea missions pays 15,000 standing at once, at Rank 5.

disclosures.title: buy it, don't farm it
disclosures.body: The community's own farm-analysis post opens by saying the standing purchase is the most economical way to get Reconifex. The drop route is 20-minute Hell-Scrub runs at 5.41% per part, or bounty RNG for the main blueprint at 3.92% with a roughly 25-run average.
